title: This Java Interface Has Zero Code... and a Full API
description:
Spring Data JPA can generate a complete CRUD data layer from a single empty interface -- no SQL, no manual queries written by hand. This Short walks through the real Task Management REST API project from the Java Mastery Path: the repository, the controller, and a live curl request hitting an H2 database. See the full project, including stretch goals like pagination and validation, at the link below.

Source lesson:
- https://sigilipelli.github.io/java-mastery-path/level-3/11-project-rest-api-db/

#Shorts

beats.narration: This one Java interface is the entire data access layer for a full REST API -- and it has zero method bodies.
Extend JpaRepository, and Spring Data JPA generates findAll, findById, save, and deleteById for you automatically, at runtime.
A thin controller calls that repository through a service layer, and now GET and POST map straight to your H2 database.
Hit that endpoint with curl, and the task is already saved -- no SQL written by hand, anywhere.

display.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/tasks \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"title": "Write Level 3 capstone docs", "completed": false}'

beats.narration: That's the whole CRUD project built layer by layer -- full source and stretch goals are in the lesson, link below.
